top5.title: Check the Website Address
top5.description: Before signing in or paying, read the full website address. A padlock means the connection is encrypted, but it does not prove that the site is legitimate.

top5.title: Pause Before Opening Links
top5.description: Unexpected links can lead to fake login or payment pages. Open the official app or type a known website address instead.

top5.title: Use Unique Passwords
top5.description: Use a different long password for each important account. A reputable password manager can create and store them for you.

top5.title: Turn On Multi-Factor Authentication
top5.description: Choose a passkey or authenticator app when available. Text-message codes are a useful fallback when stronger options are not offered.
